name: zread-pi
description: zread-pi 业务层（cli / Orchestrator / Browse / RepoAnalyzer / Types）运行在 pi 的 agent 内核（pi-ai + pi-agent-core）之上；原 agent-sdk 由 packages/agent-runtime 适配层取代。

scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:catalog && bun run test:agent && bun run test:tools && bun run test:installer && bun run test:history && bun run test:lock && bun run test:agent:http && bun run test:provider && bun run test:analyzer && bun run test:blueprint && bun run test:pages && bun run test:context && bun run test:tui
scripts.test:history: bun run packages/utils/test/history-store.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/history-command.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/history-adopt.ts
scripts.test:pages: bun run packages/orchestrator/test/e2e-page-generation.ts && bun run packages/orchestrator/test/page-output-fallback.ts && bun run packages/orchestrator/test/page-polish.ts
scripts.vendor:build: bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/telemetry/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/chord/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/ai/tsconfig.app.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/agent/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/tui/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:blueprint: bun run packages/orchestrator/test/e2e-blueprint.ts && bun run packages/orchestrator/test/context-files.ts && bun run packages/orchestrator/test/style-discipline.ts
scripts.test:tui: bun run apps/cli/test/smoke-tui.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/render-all-routes.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/real-run-check.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/output-guard.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/cli-target-dir.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/mock-generate.ts && bun run test:browse
